mainEntity.name: Can you source products directly from Chinese factories?

acceptedAnswer.text: Depending on the product, quantity and requirements, we can help search for potential Chinese manufacturers and factories.

mainEntity.name: Do I need a product link?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. You can send us a product photo, description or sourcing requirement.

mainEntity.name: Is buying directly from a factory always cheaper?

acceptedAnswer.text: Not necessarily. The best source depends on the product, quantity, specifications, customization requirements and shipping. We help explore suitable sourcing options.
Yes. We can help with supplier sourcing, purchasing, basic QC and international shipping coordination for eligible orders.

mainEntity.name: Can you help with private label or custom products?

acceptedAnswer.text: We can help search for potential Chinese manufacturers and coordinate sourcing inquiries. Custom manufacturing and sampling may require a separate quotation.
No. Our standard QC is a basic inspection for visible condition, quantity and obvious discrepancies. It is not a laboratory, technical or certification inspection.
No. We can help research and compare sourcing options, but supplier performance and product quality depend on the actual supplier and product.
